snippet.title: There Is No Game walkthrough (Both Endings) (sound)
snippet.description:
Game: There Is No Game

If you like this non-game, go have a look to the kickstarter campaign of ‘There is no game : wrong dimension’!
http://kck.st/2g5iTQm

! Doesn’t work properly on Internet Explorer, Edge and Safari !
! If you have a black screen, try to switch off Adblock or to accept the plugin permission from your browser !

Try the 2 endings to not get the badge, There Is No Badge.
-—

This game has not been reviewed on Youtube by the not game narrator himself! http://bit.ly/1CumoZ6


Not made by KaMiZoTo.

http://www.kamizoto.com/
https://twitter.com/KaMiZoTo
https://www.facebook.com/OfficialKaMiZoTo

Link to the game http://www.kongregate.com/games/KaMiZoTo_Creator/there-is-no-game


Muted walkthrough will allways give you muted videos. This video is completely muted.

Please leave a comment, like or dislike on what you think of the content.
